# Results summary (auto-generated by notebook 03)

* Data: 1,017,209 store-days, 1115 stores; promo lift +38.8%; 8x spread in store size
* **Backtest (3 rolling 48-day folds): LightGBM RMSPE 0.1273 ± 0.0111 vs seasonal naive 0.2296** (WAPE 0.0937 vs 0.1719)
* Bias-correction factor 1.000 (fit on earlier folds)
* Conformal coverage on unseen fold: 80% nominal -> 85.0%, 95% nominal -> 97.8%
* Kaggle score: (not available, see notebook)
* Drift: 4 features with PSI > 0.25, 1 with 0.1-0.25
